name: Table 1, IC 3
setup: Table 1, IC 3 (Figs. 2–3, bottom left). Same as IC 2 but with velocity wavenumber kv = 4, which gives a cleaner, regular wave train.
expect: Four regular waves. Plain LLF damps their amplitude strongly; the reduced models should keep the shape but may lose a little amplitude.
observed: Shape and phase are right, but both reduced models under-predict the q peaks slightly (q error 0.42% NN, 0.51% MCL-NN). A small, systematic amplitude loss, the same as in the paper's figure.
